selection.strategy: next municipalities after previously reviewed first 10; Amsterdam isolated for separate deep review

reviewNotes: Current official local-regulations index was checked, but no sufficiently specific current housing-regulation source was established in this pass.
No negative legal conclusion may be drawn from absence of a source in this pass; targeted follow-up remains required.
No sufficiently specific current official municipal housing-regulation source was established in this pass.
Targeted follow-up against the municipal site, Omgevingsloket/omgevingsplan and Lokale Regelgeving remains required.
No negative legal conclusion may be drawn from absence of a source in this pass.
Municipal information confirms a housing-permit regime for specified permanent-use purchase and rental housing.
Municipal information confirms purchase protection for specified homes and a four-year self-occupation/prohibition period subject to exceptions/permit.
Municipal housing overview explicitly lists an onttrekkingsvergunning product; exact current scope, exceptions and application evidence still require article-level confirmation before product use.
Municipal page confirms purchase protection, a four-year protected period and a WOZ threshold that is indexed annually; from 1 April 2026 the stated threshold is €418,100.

Municipal spatial-plan materials contain chamber-rental provisions, but several surfaced pages refer to older house-allocation instruments; current citywide legal basis and scope require targeted consolidation against the current omgevingsplan/huisvestingsverordening before publication.
Current municipal information confirms purchase protection citywide for qualifying homes; the municipal page states a 2026 WOZ threshold of €576,000 and a four-year period.
Municipal information confirms a permit route for kamergewijze verhuur when more than two and at most four persons share a home, while hospitaverhuur is treated differently.
The 2025 Huisvestingsverordening provides the formal purchase-protection basis; article-level cross-check remains required for all exceptions and transitional cases.
The adopted TAM omgevingsplan contains a permit requirement for verkamering, with an exception for one or two non-self-contained units and transition provisions for existing lawful situations.

The adopted TAM omgevingsplan also contains a permit requirement for splitting a building into two or more self-contained dwellings, subject to existing-situation exceptions and policy-rule assessment.
Geographic applicability is plan/aanduiding dependent and must therefore be evaluated against the map/location for address-level product use.
Current municipal information confirms that an omgevingsvergunning is required for splitting or verkamering and directs applicants to the omgevingsplan for conditions.
For rental of five or more rooms the municipal page states additional manager, reporting and fire-safety obligations.
Address-level omgevingsplan conditions and parking rules must still be checked before any definitive legal answer.
Current municipal pages confirm an opkoopbescherming regime for qualifying purchases from 1 June 2023, subject to exceptions and a verhuurdersvergunning.
Kamerverhuur requires an omgevingsvergunning; the municipal page states a maximum of four rooms, one adult per room and a minimum room area of 12 m², plus further conditions in official policy rules.
Woningsplitsing requires an omgevingsvergunning; municipal information states a minimum of 40 m² per new dwelling and different limits inside versus outside the built-up area.
Formal policy-rule and omgevingsplan text still require article-level consolidation before product use.
Municipal information confirms a leegstandvergunning route for temporary rental under the Leegstandwet, subject to stated conditions.
Municipal fire-safety information treats five or more separately used units as kamergewijze verhuur for the described fire-safety reporting context.
This pass did not establish a complete municipality-wide current housing-regulation framework for conversion/splitting; targeted omgevingsplan review remains required.
